name: MIRAGE-Bench
description: MIRAGE-Bench is a synthetic arena-based benchmark for evaluating retrieval-augmented generation systems across 18 diverse languages on Wikipedia, combining heuristic metrics and LLM-based judging for multilingual answer generation evaluation.
reputation: A very recent benchmark with limited public adoption so far, mainly of interest to multilingual RAG and evaluation researchers.
notes: Uses surrogate judge trained on heuristic metrics to approximate LLM judge; benchmark covers 18 languages; evaluates 19 multilingual LLMs.
